name: preflight-commands
description: Tier 1 command gate. Keep the install step named "install" — the harness fingerprints it to skip reinstalling across attempts.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install workspace dependencies. Plain install, no --no-immutable: the committed lockfile is in sync, so this matches what CI does.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: ESLint across both workspaces. Must report zero errors.

commands.name: test
commands.purpose: Core, native SDK transaction, and submission-guard regression tests. Network submission is mocked; live endpoint tests run separately.

commands.name: contract-test
commands.purpose: 17 contract tests, weighted toward revert paths. Both test and test:ci now run without the Hedera forking plugin. Use the explicit workspace test:fork command for network-dependent checks.

commands.name: build
commands.purpose: Production build, which also type-checks. Gate item G5.
